description: Add cross-compositor geometry detection for screenshots and window capture

files_modified.reason: Replaced hardcoded swaymsg window geometry detection with intelligent compositor detection supporting Hyprland, Sway, and generic Wayland fallbacks.

issues_addressed: Hardcoded swaymsg-only window geometry detection excludes Hyprland users
No fallback mechanism for unsupported or missing compositors
Window screenshots fail on non-Sway Wayland environments
Lack of cross-compositor compatibility in geometry calculation
improvements: Added Hyprland support using hyprctl activewindow with proper JSON parsing
Maintained Sway compatibility with existing swaymsg approach
Implemented interactive slurp fallback for unknown or missing compositors
Enhanced error resilience for window capture across different environments
Used command -v for robust binary detection instead of hardcoded assumptions
Consistent geometry format parsing: X,Y WIDTHxHEIGHT for all compositors
rollback_notes: Can revert to original swaymsg-only approach by restoring single geometry detection line
